storia: Two Italians killed in Kuwait drone attack; Trump says Iran war ends 'whenever I want it'
angoli_fatti: Trump's boast of control over the war's end collides with a deadly Kuwait attack Iran says it didn't carry out, and a mystery over who launched the drone.
novita_oggi: NYT, CNBC and Al Jazeera report two Italians killed in Kuwait (Al Jazeera says by drone debris); Iran denies involvement and calls it 'suspicious'; Trump says victory is 'at hand', sends an extra aircraft carrier and names Pickaxe Mountain as a target.
